title: Blow-up images: null-measurability, Lebesgue scaling by r^{−N}, and the ball identities for η_{x,r}
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^N, r ∈ ℝ, A ⊆ ℝ^N, and let η := η_{x,r} = blowUpMap x r, η(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) (with Lean's convention 0⁻¹ = 0). Then (i) if A is L^N-null-measurable, so is η(A); (ii) if r > 0, then L^N(η(A)) = (r^N)⁻¹·L^N(A) for every A (Lebesgue outer measure; precisely volume (η '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal ((r^N)⁻¹) * volume A), and for every R ∈ ℝ: η(A) ∩ B_R(0) = η(A ∩ B_{rR}(x)) and B_R(0) ∖ η(A) = η(B_{rR}(x) ∖ A) (open balls).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ) (A : Set (Rn N)), (NullMeasurableSet A volume → NullMeasurableSet (blowUpMap x r '' A) volume) ∧ (0 < r → volume (blowUpMap x r '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ N)⁻¹) * volume A ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, blowUpMap x r '' A ∩ Metric.ball 0 R = blowUpMap x r '' (A ∩ Metric.ball x (r * R)) ∧ Metric.ball 0 R \ blowUpMap x r '' A = blowUpMap x r '' (Metric.ball x (r * R) \ A))
